description: This file defines the SiloMetadataClient class, which implements the ISiloMetadataClient interface. It provides a method to asynchronously retrieve silo metadata using a grain factory to access system targets within the Orleans distributed framework.

classes.name: SiloMetadataClient
classes.description: A client class for retrieving silo metadata asynchronously within the Orleans runtime.

methods.name: GetSiloMetadata
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the metadata for a specified silo address.
